info.title: Speech recognition for .NET.
info.description: Speech recognition for .NET. Managed transcription, timing and speaker recognition. Unaffiliated with other products or companies named OneSpeech.

options.name: --model
options.description:
Tier-2 models require an explicit name; gated models
use ONESPEECH_MODEL_TOKEN after gate acceptance.

options.name: --language
options.description: Transcribe/align; en or zh embedder for speaker commands

options.name: --output
options.description: Write UTF-8 output instead of stdout

options.name: --threshold
options.description: Identify threshold in [-1,1] (default: development-fitted point, 0.493 en / 0.723 zh)

options.name: --version
options.description:
Show version
Enrollments and embeddings are in-memory only and never persisted. Identify
takes enrollment audio in the same invocation. Obtain informed consent and
check local law before processing voices (including BIPA and GDPR Art. 9).
Exit codes: 0 success, 1 model/audio/I/O failure, 2 usage, 130 cancellation.
Unaffiliated with other products or companies named OneSpeech.
